description: This file contains extension methods for the string class to support code generation in the Orleans project, including methods for converting strings to syntax representations used in Roslyn for C# code generation.

classes.name: StringExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for string manipulation to assist in C# code generation within the Orleans project.

methods.name: GetLiteralExpression
methods.description: Converts a string into a Roslyn LiteralExpressionSyntax representing a string literal.

methods.name: ToIdentifier
methods.description: Converts a string into a Roslyn SyntaxToken representing a C# identifier, handling keywords appropriately.

methods.name: EscapeIdentifier
methods.description: Escapes a string to be a valid C# identifier, prefixing with '@' if it is a C# keyword.

methods.name: ToIdentifierName
methods.description: Converts a string into a Roslyn IdentifierNameSyntax using the ToIdentifier extension.
